# House style, mechanically enforced

A style rule nobody can run is a preference. This file exists so the tests can prove that editing one key leaves every comment above and beside it untouched.

The comment on the `slug` line, the blank line before the taxonomy block and the inline comment on `governance` are all load-bearing test fixtures.
